dimensions.note: Strict typed inputs exclude credentials and raw evidence; retained summaries reject common secret and identifying content.
Every model method emits structured entry and successful-completion logs without payloads.
Validation, policy, identity, audit, evidence, timestamp, and replay failures occur before their corresponding durable transition.
Eleven tests cover upgrade attributes, lifecycle success, malformed configuration, staged-write failures, replay, policy denial, and authority boundaries.
Duplicate claims are suppressed; request and result transitions resume after either staged write fails; completed replay writes nothing.
The extension makes no external API or network calls.
No handles or network resources are opened; workspace paths are canonical policy claims below /tmp.
Published README and source use synthetic identifiers and contain no private infrastructure details.
All argument and resource objects are strict and bounded; mechanical schema-write review found exact field coverage for lifecycle, invocationRequest, and result writes.
All three resource specs declare explicit lifetime and garbage collection.
This is a bounded state machine, not a remote CRUD resource wrapper.
No external mutation occurs; strict policy and lifecycle gates precede persistence.
Lifecycle, request, and result prefixes are disjoint; every writer targeting lifecycle uses the same schema.
All retained state is read through readResource.

The lazy upgrade migrates retained 2026.08.19.4 global arguments, but the generic public method/resource contract intentionally replaces the app-specific pre-publication contract; dependent Moment Savor workflows require coordinated migration before source replacement.
